title: nats.Subscription interface requires WaitReady on every implementer
answers: adding a fake/mock NATS subscription for tests
implementing nats.Subscriber breaks with missing method WaitReady
how to satisfy the Subscription interface in tests
body: pkg/infra/nats/subscriber.go's Subscription interface (and the matching pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats.go Subscription interface) requires both WaitReady(ctx) error and Unsubscribe() error. Any fake/stub implementing this interface for tests must add WaitReady too, or the var _ Subscriber = (*fake)(nil) assertion fails to compile. This PR updated fakeSubscription in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/informer/helpers_test.go, pkg/storage/unified/informer/informer_test.go, and pkg/storage/unified/resource/notifier_nats_test.go together when the method was added.
applies: any code adding to or mocking pkg/infra/nats.Subscription or pkg/storage/unified/resource.Subscription
